evidence.title: Lykos Therapeutics Announces Complete Response Letter for Midomafetamine Capsules for PTSD
Complete Response letter, NDA 215455, midomafetamine capsules (Lykos Therapeutics), published in the FDA CRL database
MAPS Statement on FDA's Public Release of Complete Response Letter for MDMA-assisted Therapy
BREAKING: FDA Publishes Lykos Therapeutics' MDMA Complete Response Letter (CRL)

outcome.note: The sponsor disclosed the grounds first: on 2024-08-09 Lykos announced the CRL and said FDA 'requested that Lykos conduct an additional Phase 3 trial to further study the safety and efficacy of midomafetamine', a request for additional safety data together with other deficiencies, which satisfies the criterion on that date. The letter itself (dated 2024-08-08, published by FDA on 2025-09-04) confirms the safety-data grounds: the application did not 'establish the safety' of the product; unreported adverse events at two or more sites raised 'substantial concerns about the reliability of the safety data'; phase 3 laboratory data (liver analytes, electrolytes) were absent and the cardiac safety assessment was incomplete; FDA asked for a new trial to 'adequately characterize the safety'. No PDUFA extension was involved; FDA acted on the NDA that was under review in June 2024.
